<!-- This repository is a design spec: no code exists. A finding here is about the design
     or the pages that carry it, and the fastest route to a fix is naming exactly where
     the decision lives. See docs/review-guide.md for the decisions in review order. -->

## Affected page / ADR

<!-- Repo-relative path(s), e.g. docs/architecture/storage.md or docs/adr/ADR-0002-postgresql-system-of-record.md -->

## Decision handle

<!-- The ADR decision the finding sits under, by handle, e.g. "ADR-0002 d3".
     If no existing record owns it, say "none — may need a new ADR". -->

## The finding

<!-- What is wrong: a flaw in the mechanism, a contradiction between pages, a tier-boundary
     or vocabulary violation per ADR-0018, a missing "decided, not built"/"unmeasured" marker,
     an unsourced claim. One finding per issue. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Why it is wrong: the quoted sentence(s), the two pages that contradict, the source that
     contradicts the claim, the failure scenario the design does not close. -->

## Proposed change

<!-- Optional. What the fix looks like: a page edit, an ADR amendment naming the d-handle,
     or a new ADR. CONTRIBUTING.md explains which applies. -->
